title: Work Journal: an (i) hover explanation of what it does and the sources it reads, on the first-run question and in Settings
summary: The Work Journal first-run question and its Settings heading now each show an (i) icon whose hover or focus box explains what the journal does and which sources it reads; the shared dialog frame and section card gained an optional slot after the title.
